findings.violated_requirement: Semantic review routing must preserve a required review for the current candidate. Each prepare-review call overwrites semantic_review_required with the latest route result; a subsequent code-only call without --semantic-risk can set it false, allowing the completion gate to skip review checks.

BLOCKED and available-next-action decisions must account for work-item dependencies. Both functions treat any READY or ACTIVE item with empty remaining_issues as actionable without checking dependencies; a task can stay CONTINUE and the Stop hook can request work when every such item depends on an externally blocked item.

unresolved_unknowns: The frozen current-task state has no declared parent obligations or work items and remains CONTINUE, so this package does not demonstrate a final COMPLETE transition for the implementation task.
